subject: Sparrow-q cutover: prioritization of exemption lanes + external comms plan
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Torres <lisa.torres@clearsighthealth.com>, ops@clearsighthealth.com
Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Sparrow-q cutover: prioritization of exemption lanes + external comms plan

Team —

We have a ClearSight production window the week of Oct 2 for the sparrow-q family cutover (quantized v2 -> sparrow-q). They are on a high-throughput pipeline for batch transcription and asked for a two-week grace/escape hatch for their longest sequences. Legal and procurement also surfaced contract language that will require a short SOW addendum.

Asks:
- Karthik: can you confirm whether we can offer a temporary pinned routing to legacy classic-embed for up to 2 weeks for high-latency jobs, and what the cost delta looks like? I put an initial impact matrix attached.
- Marissa: CS will own the comm to ClearSight — can you review the comm draft and the customer-facing timeline in Drive? We need a one-page SL explanation + mitigation steps.
- Priya: need a proposed rollout gating rule in the API gateway (rate cap + per-customer KV cache warmup) and a fallback policy we can operationalize.

Goal: finalize exemption lane and customer comm by Sep 18 so Legal can produce the SOW amendment and Procurement can sign off.

Attachments: cutover-impact-matrix.xlsx, comm-draft-clearsight.md, exemption-intake-form.pdf

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Product Manager, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sparrow-q cutover: prioritization of exemption lanes + external comms plan

Mina —

We can support a temporary pin to classic-embed for a very small cohort. Notes from infra review:
- Pin duration: up to 14 days per customer; after 14 days we trigger mandatory migration or a manual extension request.
- Cost delta: ~1.6x per-token due to less efficient KV cache on classic-embed and additional serving nodes to isolate traffic (see impact matrix).
- Operational knobs: per-customer routing flag + TTL (we'll expose as a gateway header for CS to toggle).

Two caveats:
1) We need a CC in the SLA for degraded latency if customers opt into the pin — ops will mark as best-effort.
2) We'll require an exemption-intake form signed by the customer and countersigned by Sales/Legal (attached).

I'll add a short tech note for Priya to implement the header and fallback — ETA for rollout in staging: Sep 19, production gating by Sep 26 if we get signoff.

-karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sparrow-q cutover: prioritization of exemption lanes + external comms plan

Thanks — I reviewed the comm draft and pushed comments to Drive. Highlights:
- Customer-facing timeline needs a single line for fallback / rollback expectations ("what happens if we pull the pin").
- Add a short FAQ for engineers about performance variances and recommended batch sizes for long sequences.
- Legal requested we avoid promising a strict latency SLA while pinned; we'll offer a documented best-effort and outline remediation (credits) for misrouted requests.

I also had a quick sync with Lisa at ClearSight this morning. She asked whether we could start a parallel cache warmup the week of Sep 25 so their job ramp on Oct 2 is smoother. I'm looping her here so Legal/Eng are aware of the ask.

On the SOW: Procurement will need a one-paragraph scope describing the pinned routing and the two-week maximum; can someone draft that (Karthik/Legal)?

-Marissa
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 14:55:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sparrow-q cutover: prioritization of exemption lanes + external comms plan

Mina / team —

I'll implement the gateway routing header (X-Redwood-Pin-Legacy) and a fallback policy that first retries on the pinned path, then forces the new sparrow-q path after N retries (configurable; default N=2). Other notes:
- We'll add a per-customer KV cache warmup job that can be scheduled via the ops console. ETA to have the warmup job in staging: Sep 22.
- Telemetry: we'll emit a metric pin_usage{customer="clearsight_health"} and latency_p95_pin/latency_p95_unpinned so CS/ProdEng can track regressions.

I'll add the gateway change to the Sep 19 deploy window. If Legal/Procurement need the technical description for the SOW, I'll paste the gateway behavior (short blurb) here for copying.

-Priya
Head of Platform Product

From: Lisa Torres <lisa.torres@clearsighthealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@clearsighthealth.com, vendor.contracts@clearsighthealth.com
Date: Wed, 13 Sep 2028 14:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sparrow-q cutover: prioritization of exemption lanes + external comms plan

Hi Mina / Marissa —

Thank you for the quick turnaround and for outlining the pin option. ClearSight is supportive of the two-week pin but would like the warmup to start Sep 25 as Marissa suggested. A couple of asks on our side:
- Can you confirm whether the pin will affect our monthly invoice line-iteming? We need a short note for Procurement.
- Can you also confirm what data retention policy applies during the pinned period (we store logs for 90 days by default)?

We'll sign the exemption form once Legal provides the SOW phrasing. Vendor Contracts is looped for the procurement questions.

Best,
Lisa Torres
Head of Data Ops, ClearSight Health
